description_en: Creates a stored energy operation optimization task
description_zh: 创建储能运行优化任务
kebab_example: aliyun brain-industrial create-ess-opt-job --freq FIFTEEN_MIN --duration 1 --run-date 2025-02-12 --time-zone Asia/Shanghai --model-version latest --topo-type LOAD_ESS_SOLAR --system-data '[{"HistoryData":["example-string"],"SystemId":"1","SystemType":"ess","SystemParams":"如光伏系统参数：_sfktj_:_0,_//是否可调节：0-不可调_1-可调,一般光伏为_不可调_cfdfs_:_0,_//充放电方式：0-正放电负充电_1-负放电正充电_zjrl_:_xxx_,_//装机容量"}]' --elec-price Price=0.5 DataTime=00:00:15 --gen-price Price=0.3 DataTime=00:00:15 --location Latitude=40.027 Longitude=120.042 Altitude=10.123 --business-key stationA --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateEssOptJob

parameters.help_en:
The data frequency. The value must match the data frequency of historyData. Default value: FIFTEEN_MIN. Valid values:

FIFTEEN_MIN: 15 minutes.
FIVE_MIN: 5 minutes.
ONE_HOUR: 1 hour.
ONE_DAY: 1 day
parameters.help_zh:
默认15min；需要与historyData的数据频率一致；枚举值：

FIFTEEN_MIN: 15分钟
FIVE_MIN: 5分钟
ONE_HOUR: 1小时
ONE_DAY: 1天
parameters.name: freq

parameters.help_en:
The prediction duration in days, starting from the run date (inclusive).

This parameter is optional. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
从运行日(含)开始, 预测时长（单位：天）。

非必填，默认1天
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en: The run date, accurate to the day, in the "yyyy-MM-dd" format
parameters.name: run_date

parameters.help_en: The time zone. Default value: Asia/Shanghai
parameters.name: time_zone

parameters.help_en: The model version number. Default value: latest
parameters.help_zh: 模型对应的版本号，默认为latest
parameters.name: model_version

parameters.help_en:
The resource topology type within the site. Valid values:

LOAD_ESS: Grid power + stored energy.
LOAD_ESS_SOLAR: Grid power + stored energy + photovoltaic
parameters.help_zh:
场站内资源拓扑类型：

LOAD_ESS：市电+储能。
LOAD_ESS_SOLAR: 市电+储能+光伏
parameters.name: topo_type

fields.help_en: The historical operation data of each system
fields.help_zh: 各系统的历史运行数据
fields.name: history_data

fields.help_en: The system parameters. The parameter values vary by system type
fields.help_zh: 系统参数，各个类型的系统的参数值
fields.name: system_params

fields.help_en:
The system type. Valid values:

load: grid power
ess: stored energy
solar: photovoltaic
hvac: air conditioning
flexible: lighting
charge: charging station
fields.help_zh:
系统类型，SystemType的取值可以是：

load: 市电
ess：储能
solar：光伏
hvac: 空调
flexible：照明
charge：充电桩
fields.name: system_type

parameters.help_en: The system data, including the parameters and historical data of each system within the site
parameters.help_zh: 系统数据，包含场站内各个系统的参数和历史数据
parameters.name: system_data

parameters.help_en: The time-of-use grid electricity price changes for the target date. The time granularity is consistent with freq
parameters.help_zh: 目标日期该天的市电分时价格变化，时间粒度与freq一致
parameters.name: elec_price

parameters.help_en: The time-of-use feed-in tariff changes for the target date. The time granularity is consistent with freq
parameters.help_zh: 目标日期该天的售电上网价格的分时变化，时间粒度与freq一致
parameters.name: gen_price

fields.help_en: The altitude, accurate to 3 decimal places. Default value: 10
fields.help_zh: 海拔高度，精度到小数点后3位，默认值为10
fields.name: altitude

fields.help_en: The latitude, accurate to 3 decimal places
fields.help_zh: 纬度，精度到小数点后3位
fields.name: latitude

fields.help_en: The longitude, accurate to 3 decimal places
fields.help_zh: 经度，精度到小数点后3位
fields.name: longitude

parameters.help_en: The location information, including longitude and latitude
parameters.name: location
